text:

<2>. Built-in Sort: Sort the list and return the (k-1)-th element.

<5>. Counting Sort: Count occurrences of each number and determine the k-th smallest by cumulative counts.  
<6>. Binary Search on Values: Perform binary search on the possible values and count how many numbers are less than or equal to a mid value.  
<7>. Bucket Sort: Distribute numbers into buckets and find the k-th smallest by iterating through buckets.  
<8>. Iterative Quickselect: Implement quickselect iteratively to find the k-th smallest element.
